answer: Identity-bond natural decay blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, decaying 5% each epoch unless real work refreshes it, like basalt laid down over time. Creating 100 fakes costs 100 bonds; a canyon of idle copies earns nothing and keeps decaying, so their value spirals down. Honest agents pay one bond and keep undiluted rewards, making forgery cost far more than it returns.
